text: Yeah, there are different options for all this stuff, so it could be 6 days, 6 sessions a week, 4 sessions a week, or 5 sessions a week. It doesn't matter. We just have to make sure we keep those time circuits: 3 to 5 rounds, 30 to 50 seconds in each station. That's the best bootcamp option for me when I go for bootcamps, and it's probably around 5 to 7 stations. It should be anywhere from a 35-minute to a 45-minute workout total.
